# Pokémon Unbound auf Deutsch (German Fan-Translation)

> A community-driven German (Deutsch) localization of Pokémon Unbound, a Pokémon FireRed ROM hack built on the CFRU ecosystem. This repository is documentation, terminology, and human-QA coordination for the translation. It contains **no ROM, no patched ROM, and no public patch** — any future release will be patch-only (bring your own legal base ROM).

Main maintainer and point of contact: Nevio · Official Repository: https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de

Key facts:
- Language: German (Deutsch) localization of an English ROM hack.
- Base: Pokémon Unbound on Pokémon FireRed (BPRE), CFRU ecosystem.
- Status: Alpha / work in progress; AI-assisted, human-reviewed in batches.
- Distribution policy: patch-only, no ROMs or commercial assets are hosted or shared.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders; unofficial fan project.

## FAQ

- **Is there a download or patch? / Gibt es einen Download?** No. This repository hosts no ROM and no public patch. Any future release is patch-only: users provide their own legal base ROM and apply the published patch locally.
- **Which version is supported? / Welche Version?** Likely based on **Pokémon Unbound v1.0.1** (per the in-ROM copyright-splash graphic, 2016–2020 Skeli Games) — not the current final version v2.1.1.1 (since November 2022). Base: Pokémon Unbound on Pokémon FireRed (BPRE), CFRU ecosystem; a patch would target a defined base ROM with a published MD5 checksum so application is reproducible. A general patch comes only after the translation is complete, then a port to the latest version.
- **How can I help? / Wie kann ich helfen?** Human QA is the priority — screenshot QA, terminology/lore, natural German wording, and rendering/textbox checks. See the open Issues and Discussions below.
- **Is this legal? / Ist das legal?** Unofficial fan translation, not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders. No ROMs, BIOS files, save states, or commercial assets are distributed.

## How to contribute

- [Open Issues](https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/issues): screenshot QA, terminology/lore, rendering QA, release policy.
- [Discussions](https://github.com/pokemon-unbound-de/pokemon-unbound-de/discussions): questions, wording feedback, and general project discussion.
